scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there. I'm checking on the status of my housing loan application. Can you tell me if it's been approved, denied, or is it still pending?
dialogue.agent: The action taken on your loan application, LOAN-00178, was that the loan was originated.

dialogue.user: Originated? That's great news! So it's approved? Can you tell me what my interest rate is and what the total costs for this loan will be?
dialogue.agent: Yes, your loan has been originated. Your interest rate is 6.250%. The total loan costs are not available in your record.

dialogue.user: Okay, 6.250% is the interest rate. That's helpful to know, even if the total costs aren't available. What about the loan term? I remember applying for a 30-year loan. Is that correct?
dialogue.agent: Yes, the loan term is 360 months.

dialogue.user: Great, 360 months it is. I applied for an FHA loan, is that correct?
dialogue.agent: Yes, your loan type is FHA.

dialogue.user: That's all the information I needed. Thank you for your help. <Satisfied> I'm satisfied because the agent was able to confirm the status of my application, my interest rate, and my loan term.
